title: Moses breaks the stone tablets at the golden calf
description: Moses tells how he was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights and received the tablets of the covenant written with God's finger. The Lord said that the people had made a cast calf, and Moses went down from the burning mountain. When he saw the sin, he threw the tablets away and broke them. He burned the calf, crushed it to dust, and threw it into the stream. Then he threw himself down before the Lord for another forty days and nights, praying for the people and for Aaron so that the Lord would not destroy them.
